newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor says talks with India's Jindal off.
newsitem.headline: Usinor says talks with India's Jindal off.

text.p: France's Usinor Sacilor said on Tuesday that it was seeking a new partner in India after talks on a planned stainless steel joint-venture with India's Jindal failed.

"We stopped talks with Jindal. We are looking for other partners. This does not mean that we will not try to be active in stainless steel in India," chairman Francis Mer told a news conference on 1996 earnings.
Last February Usinor said its Ugine unit had signed an agreement with Jindal to set up a joint-venture in India.
